## Description
&#10;&#9;&#9;Hydrogen fluoride (HF) is a diatomic molecule of hydrogen and fluorine with a &#10;&#9;&#9;molar mass of 20.01 g/mol. Boiling point is 19.5 °C (67 °F). It&#39;s Colorless, &#10;&#9;&#9;corrosive gas at room temperature. It&#39;s the critical intermediate — &#10;&#9;&#9;the only practical way to bridge solid fluoride minerals to elemental &#10;&#9;&#9;fluorine gas.
